title: feat(spec): count_true / count_false — a boolean column's Yes / No counts in the list footer
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu2rdPF6kmGfUJf93RWp8ZKf)_

Fixes #35702

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: none — no page under `skills/**` lists the column summary members; the docs that do (`content/docs/ui/views.mdx`, the generated `content/docs/references/ui/view.mdx`, the `plugin-grid` README) are updated here

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgVspkxqkUdkYxY1RHf

Flow: dev-thread rule (maintainer 2026-11-20 09:22:50Z 「所有 p1 都按照新规则执行」): the card thread builds itself; L1 and the isolated L2 run in parallel at hand-back, the maintainer's 09:22Z ruling for every p1 card (deviates from contract-review.md:18 until the skill card lands).

The second and last PR of #35702 (PR 1 #35919, merged f9097340, left exactly this): the boolean 「是」/「否」 counts the card's 要做的 lists — 「补两种计算：布尔字段的「是」的条数、「否」的条数」. Clause-② is a widening: `ColumnSummarySchema` gains two members, and the derived rows of `ColumnSummaryAggregation` gain a `reads` list (`from` stays, the first of them). Contract face, L2 at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`.

Null-cell ruling: record 7051689474 on #35702 — the maintainer chose 「不算，未填单独算「空」」 (option A, 2026-11-20 22:01:58Z). `count_true` counts the cells holding `true`, `count_false` the cells holding `false` (`count_FIELD` − `sum_FIELD`, never the record count); a cell with no value is in neither and shows under 「空」 (`count_empty`), so 是 + 否 = the filled count; with every value null, or no rows, 「是」 reads 0. That is what this PR builds.

## 维护者速读

- 列表底部计算行里，开关（布尔）列的菜单最前面多了「「是」的条数」「「否」的条数」两项，选了显示成「是 12」「否 3」。这两个数目前只出现在底部计算行：服务端已能在分组标题上算出它们，但控制台的分组标题读的是另一套汇总设置，还没有画出来。
- 属于「列表页重做」专题里「列表底部计算行」这张卡的最后一部分，做完这张卡就关闭。
- 没填值的记录两边都不算，算在「空」里（按你在决策卡上的选择）；别的类型的列菜单里不会出现这两项，元数据里硬写到数字列上会在校验时被拒；出问题撤回这个改动即可。
- 无。

## What changes

- **Spec** (`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`, `view-grouping-query.ts`). `ColumnSummarySchema` gains `count_true` and `count_false`. Both map by DERIVATION, the fork-i route the four filled / empty members took — no new `AggregationFunction`, no driver change: booleans aggregate as numbers on every backend (ruling #11152, `aggregation-conformance`'s `sum(flag)` row on six backends), so `count_true` = `SUM(field)` and `count_false` = `COUNT(field) − SUM(field)`. `COLUMN_SUMMARY_AGGREGATION`'s derived rows carry `reads`, every node the member reads (`count_true`: `['sum']`; `count_false`: `['sum', 'count']`; the four filled / empty: `['count']`). `columnSummaryNodeFunctions(mapping)` is the one reading of a row's nodes; the group header compiler uses it, and so do the footer's whole-set query and the lint below. `deriveColumnSummary` reads `count_true` as the sum, `0` when the sum answered no value (no non-null cell), and `count_false` as the non-null count less the sum. `COLUMN_SUMMARY_FIELD_TYPES` / `isColumnSummaryCompatibleWithFieldType` restrict the two members to the boolean class (`boolean`, `toggle`, pinned equal to `BOOLEAN_VALUE_TYPES`).
- **Lint** (`packages/lint/src/validate-list-view-field-refs.ts`). `columnSummaryRefusal` judges a restricted member by that table: `count_true` / `count_false` over any other type is `list-view-summary-field-type-refused` (`error`). The aggregate door ACCEPTS `SUM(field)` over a number, so without this the footer would print a total under the label 「是」 and nothing would refuse it. Its `os explain` entry gains the paragraph.
- **Footer** (`ui/packages/plugin-grid`). `offeredColumnSummaries` lists Count of Yes / Count of No first on a boolean or toggle column, and only where the spec's table allows them. `wholeSetSummaryNodes` asks every node a member reads (one `SUM(approved)` and one `COUNT(approved)` serve both counts and `count_empty`). The page fallback computes them off the rows as the cell reads them: only a real `true` / `false` is a value, so a null cell is neither, as on the server. The figure is drawn as `Yes 12` / `No 3`, a plain count.
- **i18n.** `grid.summary.countTrue` / `countFalse` (the footer word, the pack's own Yes / No) and `menuCountTrue` / `menuCountFalse` (the menu entry) in all eleven packs.
- Docs: `content/docs/ui/views.mdx`, the `plugin-grid` README; generated `content/docs/references/ui/view.mdx`, `api-surface/ui.json`, `export-origins/ui.json`. Changeset `35702-boolean-yes-no-counts.md` (`@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/lint` minor, `Metadata-protocol: added`; `@object-ui/plugin-grid`, `@object-ui/i18n` patch).

Read first, by risk: `packages/spec/src/ui/view-grouping-query.ts` (the `reads` rows, `deriveColumnSummary`'s new branch, `summaryAggregationNodes`' loop), `packages/lint/src/validate-list-view-field-refs.ts` (`columnSummaryRefusal`'s restricted arm, which now resolves the field before the aggregate-kind early return), `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/useWholeSetSummary.ts` (`wholeSetSummaryNodes`).

## Tests

New:
- `packages/spec/src/ui/view-grouping-query.test.ts` — `count_true / count_false`: the compiled nodes (one `sum_approved`, the shared `count_approved`); per group, a null cell in neither count and `true + false = filled` (3 / 2 / 1 null; all null reads 0 / 0; no true reads 0); a sum that answered no value reads 0 true, a missing column reads `undefined`, a string-spelled sum reads as a number; the field-type table (boolean class only, pinned to `BOOLEAN_VALUE_TYPES`, fail-closed on shape); `columnSummaryNodeFunctions` over every row kind; the alias collision on a field named `sum_approved`. The mapping-table pin carries the two new rows and `reads` on every derived row.
- `packages/rest/src/list-view-grouping-query-door.test.ts` §7b — the real aggregate door, on driver-sql (better-sqlite3) and the in-memory tier: the compiled grouped query and the footer's whole-set query (no `groupBy`) answer each unit's and the whole set's true / false / empty counts, tallied off the seeded rows (every fourth unset); the one-row unit with no true reads 0.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-list-view-field-refs.test.ts` — refuses the two members over a number and a text field (object form too), accepts them on booleans, and agrees with the spec's table over every `FieldType`.
- `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/footerCalculationPicker-35702.test.tsx` — the boolean / toggle offer (the two counts first, no arithmetic); never on number, currency, text, select, date, lookup; a boolean column's menu lists Count of Yes / Count of No first, a pick draws `Yes 1` then `No 1`.
- `ui/packages/i18n`: `zh-Hant.ts` regenerated from `zh-Hans.ts` (`gen:zh-hant`; the first CI run's Test UI 8/16 red was this file hand-written).
- `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/footerSummaryScope-12081.test.tsx` — 300 rows over pages of 25: the yes / no / empty counts read the whole set off one `SUM` and one `COUNT` node; with no aggregate door they are the page's, labelled `(this page)`, and an unset cell is neither.

Migrated: the `COLUMN_SUMMARY_AGGREGATION` pin (`reads` on the derived rows), `view.test.ts`'s member list, the `ui/packages/types` parity list (two members added). Voided: none.

## Acceptance notes

- Card acceptance 「布尔列有「是」「否」的条数」: the boolean column's menu offers both, first; they draw at once, over the whole matched set (the existing whole-set read) or the page, labelled as the page's.
- Disclosed, not in scope: the record edit form draws an unset boolean as an unticked box (`ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/BooleanField.tsx:124,139`), while the list cell draws it as "No value". Under A an unset value is not counted as 「否」 even though the form shows it unticked.
- A `count_true` / `count_false` column's whole-set figure waits for the object's field catalogue, as every `sum` node does (`isMoneyAggregate`: a `record`-mode currency check, ADR-0144 D6); the page figure shows until then, labelled as the page's.
- The group header compiler reads no field types, so a hand-written `count_true` over a number reaching the server unlinted would answer that column's sum. The lint is the refusal (`os validate`, `os build`, the save door through the reference-integrity suite), the same tier the aggregate × field-type pairs are judged at.

## Verification

Browser (showcase, own backend :43744 + console dev :53744 off this branch, admin), evidence in `/mnt/project-files/build-seat1/35702-pr2/`:
- Field Zoo's list, the Boolean column's footer menu: Count of Yes, Count of No, then Unique, Filled, Empty, Percent filled, Percent empty, None (`b-02-boolean-menu.png`). The Number and Rating columns' menus list Sum / Avg / Min / Max and the counts, the Name and Select columns the counts only — no Count of Yes / No on any of them.
- On a personal view of Field Zoo (Name, Boolean, Number): pick Count of Yes → `PATCH /api/v1/data/sys_personal_view/ID` 200 with only `f_boolean` gaining `summary: "count_true"` → the cell reads "Yes 1" (`b-12`) → reload → still "Yes 1" (`b-13`) → pick Count of No → PATCH 200, "No 1" (`b-14`). The two seeded rows hold `true` and `false`.
- The runtime's aggregate door on the same stand, `POST /api/v1/data/showcase_field_zoo/query` with the footer's nodes answers `{ count: 2, sum_f_boolean: 1, count_f_boolean: 2 }` (Yes 1, No 1).
- The package view `showcase_field_zoo.default`: the pick's draft save answers 403 and the pick is taken back, PR 1's documented behaviour for a view a read-only package ships.
- NOT MEASURED in the browser: a null boolean cell (the showcase's Field Zoo refuses a new row without its required master-detail) and the whole-set path over more than one page (two rows); both are pinned on the real door (§7b) and in the 300-row footer suite.

Two-minute check: on any object with a boolean field, open its table view as an admin, click under the boolean column — the menu starts with "Count of Yes" / "Count of No"; pick one, the cell reads "Yes N" at once.
